title: Compute liveness patrol: cadence, rules and the files each side publishes
description: Authority: docs/COMPUTE_PATROL.md. The off-host patrol (scripts/hope_patrol/patrol.py) publishes publication.json each cycle; the host probe (scripts/hope_patrol/probe.py) publishes observations.json; the Watchdog review intake (lib/router/watchdog/compute_patrol.py) turns publication flags into Watchdog fault signals. Both sides read this file: the patrol from its own package directory, Tofu from contracts/.
x-cadenceSource: Router spec 2026-11-13: one liveness patrol cycle about every 30 minutes.

x-hangRule.justification: 910C NPU utilization reads low even on active training (2026-11-13 calibration job psxls68xru4vuomj: mean 2.14 %; live working jobs read 0.18-0.96 %), so utilization only vetoes; a job is likely hung only when NPU utilization is low AND NPU memory is flat AND worker CPU is flat over a full window. NPU memory flatness is its range (max - min): any change is NPU work, and a short burst is progress (live psxn96pxru396rfe: one burst of +69.6 pp in an otherwise idle hour). Worker CPU flatness is its decile range (p90 - p10): a heartbeat thread makes isolated blips that are not progress (live psxmwu2xru396rfe [ki-E/smoke8]: mean 0.01 with one 0.50 blip in 241 samples, decile range 0.005). Lifetime aggregates carry only mean and max; their range is then max - mean. Calibration: 2026-11-13 audit aggregates (idle: CPU <= 0.066, memory <= 0.38 pp; active: CPU 1.34, memory 2.59 pp) and the 15:28 CST live pass over the account's 60-minute series (idle at the 4.6 % NPU memory baseline: memory range <= 0.024 pp, CPU decile range <= 0.033; working jobs: memory range >= 11.8 pp). The window is two cycles because one flat cycle can be a checkpoint save or an evaluation pause. An observation older than two cycles (one missed probe run) is not judged.

x-metrics.source: MLP /mlapi/kub/job/{id}/metric/{metric}/allRoles holds one value per minute, reported as four 15 s samples; a series starting within one resolution of the requested start covers the whole window.

x-queuedRule.source: Router spec 2026-11-13: queued jobs older than about 24 h that nobody claims are flagged.

x-retentionSource: Evict-only retention of the per-day cycle log (cycles/<date>.jsonl); verdicts never depend on it.

min.description: Absent for lifetime aggregates; the range is then max - mean.

p10.description: 10th percentile of the window's samples (series only).

p90.description: 90th percentile of the window's samples (series only).

authState.description: The SSO adapter's state for the MLP ticket (ready, login_required, pending, blocked, unknown) or 'error'. Only ready reads anything.

condition.description: patrol_degraded only: which part of the patrol is degraded.

instance.description: host:pid:start of the patrol process; one live instance publishes at a time.

candidates.description: Running card jobs the host probe reads activity for.

claimed.description: Jobs a lead claimed in claims.json; never flagged while the claim lasts.
